products.note: Legal AI assistant; contract drafting; case research; law firm data exposure; privilege concerns

profile_text.body:
Harvey is a San Francisco-based company that builds AI software for legal and professional services. According to its website, the platform is designed for law firms and corporate legal teams and covers contract analysis, due diligence, compliance, and litigation workflows. The company describes itself as built to meet the standards of leading professional service firms, and in 2025 it reported customer growth, new product releases, and expanded global operations.

The company's principal product is Harvey AI, a legal AI assistant that the site positions around contract drafting, case research, and related legal tasks. Harvey states that it publishes research findings and builds alongside the open-source community, suggesting an orientation toward transparency in its model and benchmark work.

The site's held facts note a significant law-exposure count of 174 cases tied to California, alongside recorded concerns around law firm data exposure and legal privilege, areas that are relevant considerations for a platform handling sensitive client matter information. Harvey AI is tracked in the Finance and Legal AI category on theworldofai.org, and the company's profile was verified as of August 2026.
